annotations.title: Check that a QR design will scan

description: Run the print check on a design before it goes to the printer: the engine renders it and decodes it under 13 simulated conditions (small print, distance, blur, dim light, low contrast, glare, noise, rotation) and returns the same report the builder's scan panel shows, plus the minimum print size at table, wall and street distance. Call it after qr_generate when the result is going to be printed. fileFormat/outputWidth/outputHeight are ignored: the check renders its own bitmap.

additionalConfig.description: Escape hatch: any other QrConfig field the engine accepts (gradient stops, dot rotation, etc.). Merged on top of the structured fields above.

backgroundColor.description: Background color in hex (e.g. "#ffffff"). Use "transparent" for no background.

content.description: The text or URL the QR will encode. Required.

eccLevel.description: Error-correction level (L=7%, M=15%, Q=25%, H=30%). Higher levels survive more damage but are denser.

finderInnerShape.description: Shape of the inner dot of the three corner finder patterns.

finderOuterShape.description: Shape of the outer ring of the three corner finder patterns.

frameColor.description: Frame colour in hex, also the label background. Defaults to "#000000".

frameStyle.description: Call-to-action frame around the whole QR with a short label. Never covers the QR or its quiet zone.

frameText.description: Label inside the frame, max 40 characters, any language (e.g. "Scan me", "View the menu"). Defaults to "Scan me".

frameTextColor.description: Frame label colour in hex. Defaults to "#FFFFFF".

logoUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of a logo image to embed at the center.

moduleShape.description: Shape of the small modules in the QR matrix.

outputHeight.description: Output height in pixels (raster) or viewport units (svg). 64-4096.

outputWidth.description: Output width in pixels (raster) or viewport units (svg). 64-4096.

text.description: Optional caption rendered below the QR (e.g. a slogan).

name: qr_scan_check

conditions.description: One entry per simulated condition (baseline, small-print, far-away, blur, dim light, glare, noise, rotated).

readers.description: How many of the engine's two readers decoded it (0-2).

designWarnings.description: QrConfig fields the static rules flagged.

elapsedMs.description: How long the simulated scan took.

engineAdjusts.description: True when the engine had to strengthen the design for it to read back (the file differs from the request).

grade.description: Print-readiness grade: excellent, good, fair or poor.

resolutions.description: How small the modules can get and still be read: one step per tested size, largest first.

sizes.description: Minimum print size at table, wall and street distance.

smallestModulePx.description: Smallest module in the rendered bitmap, in pixels.

symbolModules.description: Modules per side of the symbol.

title: Check that a QR design will scan
